name: systole
description: Systole — a single-file cardiology board-review app built by patching a personal ACCSAP 12 export. The question bank itself is licensed content and is never committed.

comments.dependencies: The BUILD has none on purpose — it is Node's standard library and 82 patch scripts, and `npm run build` needs no install at all. devDependencies are for the TESTS only: playwright drives the suites, ts-fsrs regenerates tests/fixtures/fsrs-oracle.json and is otherwise unused (the fixture itself is committed, so verify-oracle runs without it). Both are pinned to exact versions rather than ranges, and package-lock.json pins their transitive tree, because a suite that measures a browser is measuring a specific browser.
comments.usage: npm run build -- path/to/ACCSAP_export.html   then   npm test
comments.browsers: Playwright downloads its own browsers on install. Set PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH to share one copy, and PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 where they are already provisioned. `npx playwright install chromium webkit` is the minimum for a full run; firefox is accepted by --engine and has to be installed before it will work.
